metadata.name: Peat, Isaac-Style
metadata.description:
[h1]Peat, Isaac-Style[/h1] Peat from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3778123093]Fiend Folio[/url] is drawn in runs as a cut-out from his cartoon. This mod gives him a proper in-game sprite in the style of Isaac and the other characters, after his official Fiend Folio portrait: potato nose, open mouth, double chin, ears, brown boots.
[h2]What changes[/h2] [list] [*]Body and head in the standard character layout: every walking, shooting, item-pickup and hurt animation. [*]Item costumes sit on him the same way they sit on Isaac. [*]On the horse he is drawn as a rider sitting on it. [*]Only the look changes: his stats, items and mechanics are Fiend Folio's. [/list]
[h2]Requirements[/h2] [list] [*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3127536138]REPENTOGON[/url] [*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3778123093]Fiend Folio: Reloaded[/url] [/list] Fiend Folio's files are not changed: the sprite is swapped at render time.
[h2]Links[/h2] Source code: [url=https://github.com/blackhellvelz-prog/isaac-peat-isaac-style]GitHub[/url] More from the same set: Basement Scrapbook Menu, Dead Sea Scrolls: Unrolled, Talents for Everyone, Mod Fixes & Speedups, Russian Translation for Mods.
Made with Universal Modder. Peat is a Fiend Folio character. Author: blackhellvelz.
